hero.title: Imishini iwela imingcele.
hero.intro: Ama-ejenti e-AI asevele esebenza kuwo onke amafu, izinhlangano, nezindawo ezibuswa ngokwahlukene. Kodwa lapho isistimu ezimele ihlangana nenye, ayikho iphrothokholi engachemile yokuphendula imibuzo emithathu eyisisekelo:
hero.body: Amagunya azimele angaqashela ubunikazi, anikeze amakhono, futhi ahoxise ukwethembana ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezinhlangano namazwe, ngaphandle kokudela umsuka wabo wokwethembana.
hero.notLine: Alikho igunya eliphakathi. Alikho ukuzimela okwabiwe. Alikho ifu eliphoqelelwe.

stakes.label:
Ubukhosi
I-
stakes.title:
Ubukhosi ngaphandle kokuhlukaniswa.
I-
stakes.subtitle:
Izinhlelo ezizimele zidinga ukubambisana ngaphandle kokudinga ukuqondanisa kwezombusazwe, ingqalasizinda eyabiwe, noma umsuka ofanayo wokwethembana.
I-
stakes.notLine:
I-Genesis Mesh iphatha isethi engaphansi efundeka ngomshini yalobo budlelwano: ukunakwa, ububanzi, ukuthunyelwa, ukuhoxiswa, kanye nobufakazi.
I-
stakes.boundary:
Ayixoxisani ngenqubomgomo, ayixazululi izingxabano, noma ibuse ababambiqhaza. Lezo ziseyizibophezelo zabantu kanye nezikhungo.
I-

powers.label:
Ukubambisana
I-
powers.title:
Ukubambisana akudingi ukuqondanisa.
I-
powers.subtitle:
I-Genesis Mesh ayifaki imifelandawonye. Iphrothokholi idinga ukuqashelwa kwe-cryptographic, hhayi isivumelwano sezepolitiki.
I-

close.title:
Umsebenzi owabiwe, igunya elihlukene.
I-
close.desc:
Iziphathimandla zingabambisana eduze ngenkathi ngayinye igcina okhiye bayo, inqubomgomo, namandla okuhoxisa.
I-

scoped.title:
Okwenziwayo okukodwa kunganele.
I-
scoped.desc:
Ukuqashelwa kungase kufake indima eyodwa, injongo eyodwa, noma iwindi lesikhathi esisodwa ngaphandle kokudala umfelandawonye ongunaphakade.
I-

different.title:
Ukuqashelwa akukhona ukuvumela.
I-
different.desc:
Iziphathimandla ezinezinqubomgomo ezihlukene zingaqinisekisa ubudlelwano obunomkhawulo ngaphandle kokufuna isivumelwano esibanzi sezepolitiki.
I-
examples:
Ubufakazi obusayiniwe bungena esikhundleni sokuqondana okushiwo
I-

Noma yiliphi igunya lingahoxisa ukuthenjwa kwalo
I-

mechanics.label: Indlela Yokusebenza
mechanics.title: Ingqalasizinda engafaki mapolitiki, efaka kuphela indlela yokusebenza.
mechanics.subtitle: Ingqalasizinda eminingi yokwethembana ifaka ezombusazwe zalowo ophethe umsuka. I-Genesis Mesh ifaka imisebenzi emine kuphela bese ishiya ezombusazwe emazweni azimele. Yilokho okuyenza ibe sezingeni lezivumelwano kunokuba ibe sezingeni lomhlinzeki.

ops.name: Qinisekisa
ops.desc: Ubufakazi be-cryptographic bokuthi ubani ophethe igunya: ubunikazi be-Ed25519, ama-genesis block asayiniwe, namaketanga obufakazi.

ops.name: Khawulela
ops.desc: Ukunikezwa kwamandla okunomkhawulo wobubanzi nesikhathi. Ama-capability manifest achaza lokho ubunikazi ngabunye obungakwenza, hhayi okungaphezu kwalokho.

ops.name: Hoxisa
ops.desc: Lapho nje ukwethembana kuphuka, ukuhoxisa okusayiniwe kusabalala kweqe imingcele yamazwe azimele, futhi kuyahlonishwa.

ops.name: Cwaninga
ops.desc: Zonke izinqumo zishiya ubufakazi obubonisa uma buphazanyisiwe. Akudingeki muntu avele akholwe izwi lakho.

evidence.title:
Kungani kungenjalo i-SPIFFE, DID, noma i-OAuth?
I-

protocol.label: Iphrothokholi
protocol.title: Uhlelo oluvulekile lwe-RFC, olwakheke njengamazinga, hhayi njengomkhiqizo womhlinzeki.
protocol.subtitle:
Ukuqaliswa kwesethenjwa kwe-Python kanye ne-TypeScript, Go, kanye nama-SDK e-.NET ahlanganiswe ku-v0.56.0. I-core suite inokuhlolwa kwe-1,327, enobufakazi obusemthethweni bephrothokholi obubhalwe phansi ukuze kuqinisekiswe i-Tamarin.
I-

l1.name: Umnyombo Wephrothokholi
l1.desc: Ubunikazi be-Ed25519, ama-genesis block asayiniwe, ukubhalisa, ukuhoxisa, ukuqondisa, nokucwaninga.

l2.name: Imiphakathi Ezimele
l2.desc: Izizinda zokwethembana ezizimele. Ngasinye silawula ubulungu, ukubusa, nokuhoxisa kwaso.

l3.name: Inethiwekhi Yokuqashelana
l3.desc: Izivumelwano phakathi kwamazwe azimele. Izindlela zokwethembana nokusabalaliswa kokuhoxisa kweqa imingcele.

live.title: Ukufakwa Komphakathi Okuqhutshwa Abalondolozi
live.subtitle: Okhiye Abazimele / Inqubomgomo Ezimele / Ubufakazi Obuphindaphindekayo

governance.label: Ukuphathwa Kwephrothokholi
governance.title:
Ushintsho oluvulekile, igunya elisobala.
I-
governance.description:
Izinguquko zephrothokholi zidlulela kokusalungiswa komphakathi, ukubuyekezwa komnakekeli, ukubuyekezwa komsebenzisi lapho izibopho zishintsha, ukubuyekezwa kokuvikeleka kwezinguquko ze-trust-state, nezinqumo zedethi.
I-
governance.boundary:
Ukusetshenziswa kwesithenjwa akuyona iphrothokholi. Abasebenzisi bagcina okhiye babo, izinqubomgomo, izinqumo zokwethembana, namalungelo okuphuma.
I-

silicon.label:
Ucwaningo
I-
silicon.title:
I-Compute Ebusayo
I-
silicon.subtitle:
I-TSWI ihlola isendlalelo sezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha ngaphansi kobukhulu besofthiwe: ukupakishwa okuphethwe ngu-opharetha, idizayini ye-interposer, i-orchestration, nengqalasizinda yekhompuyutha eqaphela amandla.
I-
silicon.conclusion:
Lena ithrekhi yocwaningo ehlukile, akuyona imfuneko yokwamukela iphrothokholi ye-Genesis Mesh.
I-

live.title: Akusona isithembiso. Uhlelo olusebenzayo.
live.subtitle: Ukufakwa komphakathi okuqhutshwa abalondolozi, okunobufakazi bephrothokholi obungaphindwa ngokuzimela.

closing.title:
Yakha nge-Genesis Mesh.
I-
closing.subtitle:
Khetha indlela yokutholwa efana nendima yakho ngaphandle kokunikela ngezinqumo zakho zokuthenjwa.
I-

builders.title: Sungula isizinda sakho sokwethembana esizimele.
builders.desc: Funda ama-RFC, landa ama-SDK e-TypeScript / Go / .NET, bese usungula i-L2 Sovereign Community engqalasizindeni osuvele ungumnikazi wayo.

strategic.title:
Linganisa iphrothokholi, ubufakazi, kanye nomngcele wokubusa.

strategic.desc:
Buyekeza izakhiwo zomphakathi kanye nobufakazi obuphindaphindekayo, bese uvula umzila oqondile wemibuzo yesikhungo.

seo.title: Genesis Mesh - Ungqimba Lwezivumelwano Lwemishini
seo.description: Indwangu ezimele yokwethembana, yobunikazi neyokuxhumana yezinhlelo ezizenzelayo. Ayichemi ekuzimeleni futhi isezingeni lezivumelwano: qinisekisa, khawulela, hoxisa, cwaninga. Akuyona i-blockchain. Akuyona i-VPN. Akuyona i-service mesh.

trustCycle.title: Isicelo esifanayo siba nomphumela ohlukile lapho ukwethembana kushintsha.
trustCycle.subtitle: Amasistimu amabili abuswa ngokuzimela asungula ukuqashelana okunomkhawulo, enze isinqumo sokugunyaza, asabalalise ukuhoxiswa, futhi akhiqize ukwenqatshwa okungacwaningwa ngaphandle kokwabelana ngomsuka wokwethembana.
trustCycle.sameRequest: Ubunikazi obufanayo. Isicelo esifanayo. Isimo sokwethembana esihlukile.
